body:
## Result and scope

Refs #45
Refs #26

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/45#issuecomment-6825442455, session `ADB991-claude-20261112-5b03`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: C04 package of YM-000026. Edited `manuscript/existence/{complex-heat,reconstruction,boundary-detection,spectral-measure}.tex`; added `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/` (author report). The other seven C04 chapters were audited and left unchanged.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. No subagents.

All eleven C04 chapters were read in full and checked step by step: signs, quantifiers, domains and limits.

**One genuine gap, now repaired.** Proposition `prop:word-motion` assumed `(eq:word-motion-input)`: the word kernel is invariant under the Poincaré action, K(gb,gc)=K(b,c), and g↦K(b,gc) is continuous. No chapter of the draft proved this; the text said it was "to be established before this construction is applied". The pinned source proves it as `YM.Work.C28.answer`, which is missing from `reconstruction-evidence.md`. A new Corollary `cor:word-motion-inputs` in `boundary-detection.tex` proves it in detail, following C28's steps:
1. the star commutes with the motion;
2. invariance follows from g=(a,I)(0,Λ), translation invariance and Lorentz covariance;
3. continuity follows by pinning the labels in one finite level and using Schwartz continuity of the pullback.

**New same-data edge.** The corollary needs the involution J of `input:calibrated-actions` (C14) to be the reflected conjugate J of `reflection.tex` (C03). This is not a convention: θκ commutes with K_a=-iL_a, while κ alone anticommutes with it. The point is recorded after the corollary and in the ledger.

**Notation, no mathematical change.**
- V denoted both the unitary time group and the isometry H→H_E, and both appeared in the proof of `thm:field-spectrum`. The isometry is now 𝒱.
- reconstruction.tex used U_E for the joint Euclidean translations. It now uses T_E, as the other chapters do.
- h_t(ab) is now h_t(τ_a b), so translation is no longer confused with concatenation.

No other substantive defect was found. Global closure is **not** claimed. The incoming premises from C03 and C14 (Euclidean semigroup, slab bounds, levels, Euclidean axioms, calibrated actions, null-space equality, unique heat ground space) remain explicit inputs and are listed with edge IDs in [ledger.md](https://github.com/ADB991/humanise-yang-mills/blob/claude/issue-45-5b03/blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/ledger.md). Observations for G01, G03 and G06 are in [findings.md](https://github.com/ADB991/humanise-yang-mills/blob/claude/issue-45-5b03/blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/findings.md). One of them is a theorem-number mismatch for the Williams citation: Thm 2.19 in the text, Thm 2.13 in the bibitem.
